summary: Defines IS-IS extensions that let a Path Computation Client automatically find Path Computation Elements and learn their capabilities. It parallels the OSPF extensions in RFC 5088. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Routers needing help planning routes can ask around who the planners are. This lets IS-IS announce which servers are route planners and what they are good at.

questions: how to discover pce with is-is
